svg.title: A first page for somebody on no team — SoftTrack web design mockup (#318)
svg.desc: An account with no team is sent to a form for creating one. The page that replaces it links to People, the profile, expenses and, for a finance admin, Finance; lists the teams there are and who administers them; and offers creating a team as one option among these.
svg.text: A first page for somebody on no team
· People, your profile, your expenses, and who to ask

svg.text: Done when an account with no team gets a page that links to People, its own profile and settings, its expenses, and Finance when it has finance access; creating a team is one
option on it and absent where the account may not create teams (#306); the page says who to ask (#259); and #258 replaces it once that exists.

g.text: Who to ask, by name. Asking from
here is #259; until it lands the list
names the admins and stops there.
Finance was reached by typing its address. Now it is on the page
No form that would be refused. The page says who creates teams
The first thing SoftTrack suggests to a junior engineer on day one
